title: Reconciler: tracker writes must be durable — commit and push .tick/ to the integration branch after every claim, note and close
description:
Found by the Phase 1 gate run (cc5, run gate-cia on ticks epic cia, 2026-09-08). The reconciler's tracker writes (Tracker.Claim / Note / Close via tk in --repo) land as UNCOMMITTED working-tree edits in the reconciler checkout on main and never reach origin: after uhw and uqe were closed behind their gates, origin/main and origin/epic/cia still showed them status open, the checkpoint said closed, and the worker for the dependent tick t62 (branched from origin/epic/cia) read .tick/issues/uhw.json as open and answered BLOCKED — the run failed. This violates 'close durably through tk only after the gate' (durable means pushed on origin) and the two-authority model (tracker and git). Fix in internal/reconcile: every tracker write is followed, in the same step, by committing .tick/ and pushing it to the EpicRun integration branch epic/<id> on origin through the same CAS discipline the run-state store uses (push --force-with-lease, conflict is a typed outcome); the attempt worktrees of later waves and the review/closeout role jobs must see the closes because they branch from the integration branch. Design choice is yours (decide and log): run tk against a worktree checked out on the integration branch, or commit the checkout's .tick/ edits onto epic/<id> with plumbing after each write — either way the reconciler's checkout must not be left dirty and main must not be written. Also: after a restart, a tick whose checkpoint state is 'rejected' from a BLOCKED runner answer with no commits must be re-dispatched as a NEW attempt once its blockers are closed in the tracker (verify what happens today and make it so). Tests: extend the fixture epic end-to-end test to assert that after wave 1 closes, origin/epic/<id> carries .tick/issues/<tick>.json with status closed and the checkout is clean; a wave-2 attempt's worktree sees its blockers closed; the three restart tests still pass; lifecycle suite green. Scope: internal/reconcile (and internal/tk only if a helper is needed). Do not touch internal/exec.

## How this fits
Wave 5 of epic qeu, alongside the gate-run tick cc5 (report only). Integration commit 64bda54244d05e781956dbfcea16077cbfcff56b on epic/qeu contains everything (reconciler px2/q4u, executor, run-state store, tk client incl. the embedded-manifest fix u65). Read internal/reconcile/doc.go, gate.go closeTick, dispatch.go claim, rolejob.go, integrate.go (how the integration branch is manipulated in a detached worktree) and internal/runstate (the CAS push discipline) first. Stdlib only; no go.mod/README/contracts edits. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor 64bda54244d05e781956dbfcea16077cbfcff56b HEAD.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture epic: after each close, origin/<integration-branch> carries the tracker records with status closed and the reconciler checkout is clean; a dependent wave's attempt sees closed blockers; restart tests and lifecycle suite green; go test -short ./... green
